digest.component_or_area: rebar review CLI verb and llm.review_ticket library/MCP surfaces
propositions: rebar review is superseded from above by the signed review-plan gate and from below by LLM-free checks, and must be retired safely without breaking existing agents and scripts.

The CLI verb must become a loud deprecation shim over review-plan that rejects unsupported arguments (--graph, positional reviewer_id) with exit 2 and a helpful message, rather than silently accepting and discarding them.

The public library function rebar.llm.review_ticket must split into _review_ticket_impl (the implementation) and a deprecation wrapper, so internal call sites (MCP tool, eval harness, diff harness) can call the impl and emit exactly one deprecation signal per boundary, not multiple overlapping warnings.

The shim must pass --no-sign to review-plan to preserve the old verb's read-only semantics (no attestation written), and must document and test the behavioral divergence that review-plan fast-fails on non-claimable tickets whereas the old verb would have run the model.

Three deprecation rows (cli:rebar review, lib:rebar.llm.review_ticket, mcp:review_ticket) must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY with permanent=False and remove_in=v1.0.0, and OUTPUT_SCHEMAS["review"] must map to plan_review_verdict with review_result re-wired under a synthetic "review_ticket" key.
